title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Schedule of Unfound-Line Room Top-Ups
content:
**Cartwise Grocery Orders — room top-up for lines recorded as not found.** When a line is billed although the shopper recorded its product as not found, the refund room for that line is topped up according to the calendar days since the order was completed.

| Calendar days from the date of completion to today | Missing refund already standing on the order | Top-up to the unfound-line room |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | none | 5.00 |
| exactly 1 | none | 2.50 |
| 0 | none | no top-up |
| any number | one or more | no top-up |

**Terms.** The unfound-line room top-up is added to the room before the refunds already granted are taken off: when at least 2 calendar days have passed from the date of completion to today and no missing refund stands on the order yet, the top-up is 5.00; when exactly 1 calendar day has passed and no missing refund stands on the order yet, it is 2.50; otherwise there is no top-up.

**Notes to the schedule.**

1. Days are counted in calendar dates from the date part of the order's completion time; the completion date is day 0. An order completed at 23:50 and looked at five minutes after midnight is at day 1.
2. "No missing refund stands" means no item refund entry with the missing reason is on the order, on any line.
3. The top-up joins the room at the point where the room has been set from the cap and not yet reduced by the refunds already granted; the zero floor on the room applies after those refunds are taken off.

**Hypothetical example.** A room set at 42.19 before deductions, on an order completed three calendar days ago with no missing refund on it, becomes 47.19 with the top-up; with 38.00 of refunds already granted, the room is 47.19 less 38.00, that is 9.19.
